findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_mcp_server, check_domain_trust, sanctions_screen, safety_pass · Private data: scan_mcp_server, scan_github_repo, check_domain_trust, scan_for_leaks, business_check, code_safety_report · Public sink: scan_tool_definitions, check_domain_trust, scan_for_leaks, safety_pass · Destructive: scan_github_repo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_mcp_server, check_domain_trust, sanctions_screen, safety_pass · Private data: scan_mcp_server, scan_github_repo, check_domain_trust, scan_for_leaks, business_check, code_safety_report · Public sink: scan_tool_definitions, check_domain_trust, scan_for_leaks, safety_pass · Destructive: scan_github_repo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
